name: JAZZ TRIO
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless jazz piano trio in a small club. Walking bass, brushes, bebop lines.
description: JAZZ TRIO turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a piano trio playing an endless set in a small club. Every tune is new: medium swing, up tempo, ballads, blues, rhythm changes, modal tunes and jazz waltzes on original changes. The trio plays the head, piano solos that build chorus by chorus, sometimes a bass solo or fours with the drums, the head out and an ending; the room applauds and the next tune is counted in. On screen, the view from a table: a spotlight that finds the soloist, a candle, the chord on a chalkboard. Thirteen bands.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
